Author: AlexFlipnote
Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog: "Fade unavailable actions" is now "Fade synced down actions". It only fades hotbar actions that are above your current level, like when you are synced down in a duty, instead of fading anything the game could not use right now. Cooldowns, missing resources and being out of range no longer fade your actions, so the hotbar stays calm during normal play.
